fieldValues.title: P3 AI-Assisted Decisions
fieldValues.summary: AI reads a live or recorded transcript, proposes stage-appropriate text with provenance, and people edit, agree and ratify it.
fieldValues.body:
## Track

P

## Actor

Group using AI inside the current SRS-web Protocol workspace

## Durable Artifact

Human-ratified decision with transcript-linked AI proposal provenance.

## Entry Criteria

- F2 and P2 walkthroughs pass
- Addressability and Protocol runs are available

## Included Capabilities

- Collaborate With AI
- Work With Meaning
- Preserve Meaning

## Exclusions

- AI authority over commitment
- Federation
- A separate AI-specific editor or canonical store

## Walkthrough

In the same SRS-web Protocol workspace, use a live transcript, request a stage recommendation, edit it with the group, ratify the resulting decision and inspect the source provenance.

## Compatibility Promise

AI assistance never silently commits canonical meaning; attribution and human ratification remain inspectable.

## Stable After

AI may participate as a transparent coach inside a human-owned decision practice.

## Gaps

- TSS schema and transcript-ingestion contract: muDemocracy.org#60: Create concrete stories after P2 establishes the manual Protocol run.
- AI-assisted meeting walkthrough: muDemocracy.org#60: Create when transcript ingestion and stage recommendations have runnable surfaces.
